text.card: A star about 48 parsecs away, 3.0 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.0 solar radii and 2.05 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,603 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Tau Pegasi
quotes.card: Tau Pegasi, formally named Salm, is a magnitude 4.6 star 162 light-years away in the constellation of Pegasus.
quotes.introduction: With about twice the mass of the Sun and thirty times as luminous, it is a δ Scuti variable star with its brightness changing by a few hundredths of a magnitude over about an hour.
